subject: Throughput & isolation: follow-up and provisional sizing
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@calyxthera.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Throughput & isolation: follow-up and provisional sizing

Hi Elena — thanks again for your time earlier. Quick recap from our call and the provisional sizing we discussed so we can align with procurement and your infra/security leads.

Key pain points you called out:
- Data isolation: all inference must run in a customer-isolated environment (VPC) with strict egress controls for PHI.
- Predictable throughput during clinical-hour peaks (weekday 08:00–18:00) and ability to burst for batch reprocessing.
- Latency SLOs for interactive workflows (physician-facing UI) and high throughput for offline batch jobs.
- Compliance proofs: SOC 2 Type II + audit logs are required before any production rollouts.

Goals we aligned on:
1) A private/dedicated pool that we can reserve (no shared tenancy) running in your VPC.
2) Baseline capacity to meet 150–200 inference requests/sec for small prompts (avg 60 tokens), with burst to ~500 req/sec for batch windows.
3) P95 latency target: <=150ms for small prompt path; P99 under review for longer sequences.
4) 99.95% uptime SLA and 24/7 incident escalation for the critical inference path.

Provisional sizing & architecture notes (ballpark):
- Initial committed pool: 8x A100-class GPUs (mixed tenancy: isolated pool dedicated to Calyx).
- Burst pool: up to +4 GPUs via reserved-but-burstable capacity for scheduled batch windows.
- Runtime optimizations: activation quantization + KV caching for short-context interactive requests to hold p95 latency under target.
- Canary: a two-instance canary (2 GPUs) for validation before full cutover.

Immediate next steps (action items):
- I attached a short draft MOP (calyx_draft_mop.pdf) and our provisional throughput spreadsheet (rdw_throughput_estimate.xlsx). Please review and flag any missing items.
- Elena: could you loop in your procurement and security leads (we noted procurement@calyxthera.com as the contact) so we can surface the SOC 2 artifacts and discuss commercial cadence?
- Internal: Ben/Evelyn, can you review the sizing spreadsheet and confirm if the 8+4 model is feasible on our Dedicated offering and whether the proposed canary will satisfy validation requirements?
- I'll propose a 30-minute follow-up on Thu at 09:00 PT to walk the MOP and procurement asks unless you prefer a different time.

Thanks — will be concise on the next call and bring a short SOW sketch for procurement.

Best,
Logan Wright
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
logan@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: calyx_draft_mop.pdf (summary SLOs & runbook), rdw_throughput_estimate.xlsx (provisional GPU sizing)

From: Elena Rossi <elena@calyxthera.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@calyxthera.com
Date: Tue, 24 Aug 2027 18:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Throughput & isolation: follow-up and provisional sizing

Logan — really helpful, thanks. A couple quick clarifications from our side:

- Isolation: we must run inside our AWS account/VPC. Network egress has to be whitelisted and auditable. Can your Private offering support a customer-managed NAT and private endpoints?
- Compliance: SOC 2 Type II evidence + periodic pen-test reports are gating criteria. Do you have an upload flow for secure artifact transfer?
- Throughput: the 150–200 req/sec baseline matches our expectations for interactive clinicians. The burst to 500 req/sec is optimistic but aligns with batch reprocessing windows — we'd likely schedule those overnight over a 4–6 hour window.
- Budget: preliminary procurement number is ~$420k ARR for a committed pool + support (we'll finalize in SOW).

Procurement has asked for a short (1–2 page) SOW and a line-item pricing sheet to compare to our internal supplier matrix. If you can send draft SOW + pricing, we'll route internally next week.

Elena
Director of Engineering | Calyx Therapeutics
elena@calyxthera.com

Subject: Re: Throughput & isolation: follow-up and provisional sizing (internal)

Quick internal notes for the follow-up:
- I'll validate the spreadsheet tonight against available Dedicated clusters and confirm whether A100-class instances can be reserved in the customer's region without a cross-region fallback.
- Need Elena to confirm model family + max sequence length and average token counts per request. If they're running larger seqs (>=1024) we should adjust the GPU count.
- Suggest we propose a pilot (2 GPUs, isolated) that mirrors their interactive path and runs for 2 weeks — that covers validation and observability for p95 latency. If pilot looks good, we scale to the full committed pool.

Evelyn — can you prep SOC 2 artifacts and the audit log export instructions so procurement has a secure upload path? I'll draft a recommended pilot SLO section to insert into the SOW.

— Ben
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.ai>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Aug 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Throughput & isolation: follow-up and provisional sizing

Elena — thanks for the quick reply and the budget signal; that's helpful.

I've attached a one-page draft SOW inside calyx_draft_mop.pdf and the provisional line-item pricing is embedded in rdw_throughput_estimate.xlsx. Highlights:
- Pilot option: 2x GPUs, isolated, 14-day validation window (no charge beyond committed demo support).
- Proposed committed pool: 8x GPUs with +4 GPU burst (monthly commit term with quarterly review).
- SLAs: target 99.95% uptime; p95 latency target <=150ms for interactive path; expanded monitoring and 24/7 on-call coverage for Sev1.

Next call: Thu 26 Aug, 09:00 PT — I'll send a calendar invite unless procurement prefers Tue morning. Please let me know and we'll attach the SOW to the invite.

Thanks all — will keep this short on the call and bring Ben/Evelyn to cover technical and compliance questions.

Best,
Logan Wright
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
